title: THE MARKET IS STALLING BECAUSE A BIG MOVE IS COMING! SPY QQQ.
speaker: Money Making Market host

macro_themes.view: VIX expiration on Wednesday the 21st (OPEX on the 16th) is a window to watch for a volatility turn.
If the VIX daily chart curls up from its higher low, big volatility could come in; a sharp VIX breakdown without divergence would let bulls squeeze higher.

calls.condition: If the VIX 2-hour confirms down and breaks without divergence, bullish for stocks; if the daily curls up, expect a volatility spike.
calls.reason: VIX tightening on the daily with a possible higher low; 2-hour rolling but watching for divergence into vixiration.
calls.quote: if the daily chart curls to the upside, it's going to be risky

calls.condition: If the SPY 2-hour curls up into positive territory and squeezes through 783.15, target the 788.22 weekly expected move and 794.55 by month-end, possibly ~800.
calls.reason: 2-hour still has room to curl up; volatility breakdown would confirm upside toward weekly/monthly expected moves.
calls.quote: To get to our easy targets up here of 78822, that weekly expected move or even hey 79455 by the end of the month

calls.condition: Likely tags the weekly expected move lower; a confirmed higher low or divergence there could start a move back up. Bear case needs a break of 731.50.
calls.reason: QQQ failed its higher low and went negative on the 2-hour, so more selling to the weekly expected move is likely; only a MACD divergence so far.
calls.quote: we see more selling which means we are very likely to go tag that weekly expected move

calls.condition: Needs a 2-hour confirmation (green bar) tomorrow; then test the high and target next week's weekly expected move.
calls.reason: 2-hour MACD curling up as a higher low, closer to center line than SPY/QQQ.
calls.quote: I'm leaning towards this 2-hour confirming to the upside completely tricking everyone
